name: RING-NeRF
definition: A versatile and simple NeRF architecture that introduces two inductive biases: a continuous multi-scale representation of the scene and an invariance of the decoder’s latent space over spatial and scale domains, enabling intrinsic continuous LOD without explicit supervision.
summary: RING-NeRF is a neural field architecture that produces intrinsic continuous level-of-detail without supervision, distinguishing itself by using summation rather than concatenation for multi-resolution features.
